correctness.rationale: The frozen statement that every finite C_j varies strictly with beta and theta is false for C_1=q_1. The repair explicitly restricts strict sensitivity to finite thresholds with j>=2, treats below-threshold washout, and scopes the stability classification off the entry supplies. Positive stationarity forces q_i<R and q_i>(1-theta)R; an omitted species with q_i<R precludes attraction even relative to nonnegative states, since its per-capita rate would eventually be strictly positive along a supposedly converging trajectory started with positive abundance. So the only candidate support consists of q_i<R; if nonempty, it includes species 1 and requires R<B. The summed mass balance yields the continuous strictly increasing closure H on (q_1,B), diverging at B, and H(q_j) gives each finite entry. For the active subsystem the stated diagonal quadratic form cancels consumer–resource couplings; the exchange blocks are positive semidefinite by their determinant and the only invariant zero-dissipation trajectory is zero (the local balances force x_i=0 once y=z=0). The decoupled absent eigenvalues are strictly negative away from entry. The all-supply ceiling only uses the necessary support condition, not stability at a boundary. A separate exact-rational replay verified both threshold examples, including C_2=46/5 at theta=1/4, and all seven stationarity equations at R_0=979/130, theta=1/2.
residual_risks: The rational examples are not used to certify all-parameter stability. Nonlinear stability at the critical supplies and global convergence remain unclassified here.

value.rationale: This determines exactly how survival changes with supply and whether increasing supply can ever admit a species, rather than only showing that coexistence sometimes occurs. The strict finite exclusion bound, explicit entry locations, and local stability tie that classification to a specified scientific model with finite exchange. The first threshold is correctly constant, so its comparative statics are not overclaimed.
residual_risks: Mathematical survivor abundance need not be experimentally detectable; there is no global dynamical or adaptive-isolation conclusion.
